scripts.check: pnpm run check:py && pnpm run check:web
scripts.check:py: pnpm run lint:py && uv run pytest
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy
scripts.check:web: pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint:py && pnpm run check:web && uv run --env-file .env pytest -m "not redis and not live" --cov=agentprobe_core --cov=agentprobe_api --cov-report= && pnpm run coverage
scripts.coverage: uv run coverage report --include="*/agentprobe_core/*" --skip-covered --fail-under=80 && uv run coverage report --include="*/agentprobe_api/*" --skip-covered --fail-under=80
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --env-file .env alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
